attchmntText: Medico Remedies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Medico Remedies Limited approved unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board also appointed M/s V. J. Talati & Co. as Cost Auditors for the financial year ending 31 March 2027. Revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 14337.26 lakhs, with a profit before tax of Rs. 661.00 lakhs. Profit for the period stood at Rs. 489.68 lakhs. Basic earnings per share was Rs. 0.53. Total assets as at 30 September 2026 were Rs. 20204.14 lakhs. The Board Meeting commenced at 4:30 P.M. and concluded at 5:15 P.M. on 9 November 2026.
